comparison.objective: Peel the correct day label and adhere it flat to a food-tub lid; not separate mixed rigid parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-sheet peeling, placement, and progressive adhesion versus load-shared screen lifting and agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct label wholly placed, four quarters adhered, released for 1 s; wrong-label and tub-disturbance failures.
comparison.reason: Tests adhesive-sheet handling rather than physical sieving.
